literal_meaning: সাতে বা পাঁচে নেই (not in seven or five)
similar_in_english: Not my circus, not my monkeys
example_sentences_in_bangla: যা হবে হোক, আমি সাতে-পাঁচে নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: I'm staying out of your argument.
note: The idiom implies complete disinterest, often used to distance oneself from responsibilities or disputes.
